4572.note_text: (1) “Introduced” includes procedures such as: keying in, recalling from a data storage, or inserting via an interface. (2) “Predetermined” means that a tare value is determined once and is applied to other weighings without determining the individual tare values.

4570.note_text: umerical value, representing a weight value, that is introduced into the instrument. It is a predetermined tare value that is used for one or several weighings
